text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired — Auth JWT validation error rate > 5% (service: auth-service, env: prod) :rotating_light:

pagerduty: [ALERT] auth-service JWT validation spike — triggered on 5xx/401 ratio threshold.

jamie (eng-oncall): acked on PagerDuty, I'm on it.

jamie (eng-oncall): seeing a surge in 401s hitting token-validate endpoint. quick check: 12% of requests failing in last 5m.

samir (sre): any recent deploys to auth-service or key rotation jobs?

maria (auth): I rolled a signing-key update 10m ago to rotate expiring key. deployment finished, but I saw a warning during publishing to JWKS bucket. digging.

jamie (eng-oncall): can you paste the warning / logs?

maria (auth): logs:
```
WARN 2026-03-14T01:07:12Z jwks-publisher - missing `kid` field for key id=null, skipping publish for entry
ERROR 2026-03-14T01:07:13Z jwks-publisher - partial publish completed; 1/3 keys propagated
```

maria (auth): looks like the new key published without a `kid`, so tokens signed with it don't match cached JWKS entries -> validation fails.

jamie (eng-oncall): that would explain the 401s. we need a mitigation plan: options: 1) roll back to previous signing key, 2) accept unsigned kidless tokens? not feasible, 3) re-publish public JWKS with correct kid mapping and force invalidate caches.

samir (sre): can we re-publish correct JWKS quickly and flush CDN/cache layers? how long to propagate?

maria (auth): i can re-publish right now with correct `kid` and force a version bump. public JWKS endpoint: `https://jwks.prod.redwood.ai/.well-known/jwks.json`
I'll push the corrected file and then touch the cache-buster key in cloudfront.

jamie (eng-oncall): do that, please. ping here when done. i'll put a quick status message to customer-facing Slack and start an incident page.

maria (auth): published corrected JWKS and bumped `jwks_version=20260314-1`. command I ran:
```
aws s3 cp jwks_v2.json s3://jwks-prod/jwks.json --acl public-read && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E1XXXXXXX --paths /jwks.json
```

maria (auth): cloudfront invalidation requested, edge nodes show new object in some regions already.

samir (sre): initiating cache flush on internal auth service instances (in-memory jwk cache) — calling `/admin/keys/refresh` on auth-service pool.

jamie (eng-oncall): running health checks against token-validate with a signed test token (uses new kid).

jamie (eng-oncall): quick test: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <test-token-with-new-kid>" https://auth.prod.redwood.ai/token-validate`

jamie (eng-oncall): response now 200 from the test. metrics show validation error rate dropping to 2% in last 2m.

pagerduty: Alert acknowledged by jamie (eng-oncall).

samir (sre): rolling restart of 6 auth-service replicas to ensure they pull latest JWKS - doing in waves of 2.

leo (sre-next): joining handoff — I'll take over once jamie signs out. if anything spikes again i'll take pager duty.

jamie (eng-oncall): customer impact assessment: about 12% of token-validated requests were 401s for ~14 minutes peak. error localization: largely API gateway caches around eu-west; couple of high-volume customers reported intermittent auth failures. ops notes saved in incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incident/2140001234

maria (auth): root cause preliminary: publisher process serialized a key entry missing `kid` due to a regression in the key-metadata generator. public JWKS was missing mapping to the signing key, so validation failed until republished.

jamie (eng-oncall): mitigation: republish corrected JWKS + CDN invalidation + in-memory cache refresh + rolling restarts. status: all done. monitoring for 15m.

samir (sre): I'll keep an eye on alerts and error rates. setting a temporary extended retention on auth logs for next 2h.

jamie (eng-oncall): great. i'll start on a quick postmortem draft (root-cause, timeline, remediation) and add followups: add pre-deploy validation for JWKS completeness, add automated check for `kid` presence in publisher, and a canary for JWKS propagation.

leo (sre-next): ack. i'll take over on-call at 02:00 UTC and watch for any regression. jamie, you can hand off now.

jamie (eng-oncall): handing off to @leo. I'm signing out of the pager for this rotation. thanks everyone. :slightly_smiling_face:

incident-bot: Incident status set to MONITORING — no active customer-facing outage. postmortem assigned to maria (auth) and jamie (eng-oncall).

jamie (eng-oncall): closing thread here; will update with postmortem link when ready.

leo (sre-next): noted. closing my loop after 30m of stable metrics.

(Reaction notes: :white_check_mark: many)
